newsitem.title: USA: Chart Industries sees record '97 results.
newsitem.headline: Chart Industries sees record '97 results.

text.p: Chart Industries Inc said on Monday it expects improved demand and a high backlog to provide record 1997 results.

"With our existing order backlog and the continuing market demand for our products, I am confident that Chart will set new records for sales and income in 1997," chairman and chief executive officer Arthur Holmes said in a statement.
Chart Industries, which reported improved fourth quarter results, said its backlog increased to a record $128 million at December 31, 1996.
On September 30, 1996, Chart Industries reported a backlog of $125.5 million, it said.
The company said it is continuing plans to increase factory production rates above current levels.
